_comment: Authored, approximate street centrelines for the DEEPTRACE downtown Atlanta demo. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] (WGS84). Every feature is ESTIMATED: drawn from general knowledge of the street grid, NOT traced from a surveyed or licensed dataset. Use the OSM ingestion pipeline to replace them with publicly mapped geometry.

provenance.source: DEEPTRACE authored street alignment (general knowledge, not surveyed)
provenance.notes: Approximate centerline authored from general knowledge of the downtown grid; may deviate tens of metres from the true alignment. Replace via `python -m app.ingest.overpass` + `python -m app.networks.generate --use-osm`. Modelled as a single two-way centreline; grade-separated from surface streets except at ramps.
